seoTitle: AI Crawler Policy Comparator: Compare robots.txt Files
metaDescription: Paste several robots.txt files and compare how each treats GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended and other AI crawlers. Free.
intro: Builds a table of AI crawlers against the robots.txt files you paste.
why:
To see where you stand, compare your AI crawler policy with other sites in your field. The policy is in each site's robots.txt, and archived copies work too.

Paste each file after a line === name and read the crawler-by-site table, with a count of blocked crawlers per site. The page makes no network requests, so you fetch the files yourself.
howTo: Open each robots.txt and copy it.
Paste each after a === name line.
